items.docs:
List options contracts.

Returns options contracts for a given underlier with options-specific metadata.
Exactly one underlier identifier must be provided.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term applied case-insensitively to ticker symbols, alternate identifiers (CUSIP, ISIN, OPRA root), and company names for non-option instruments. Option searches match symbols and alternate identifiers.

params.name: asset_class
params.description: Comma-separated asset classes (EQUITY|OPTION|WARRANT|BOND|FX|OTHER). Defaults to EQUITY.

params.name: include_inactive
params.description: Include inactive instruments. Default false.

params.name: include_ptp
params.description: Include publicly traded partnership (PTP) instruments. Default true (penalized in ranking).

params.name: currency
params.description: Optional ISO currency filter (e.g., USD).

params.name: country
params.description: Optional listing-country filter (e.g., US).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to return per page. Only used when page_token is not provided.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Token for retrieving the next or previous page of results. Contains encoded pagination state; when provided, page_size is ignored.

items.docs:
Search instruments by symbol, alternate identifier, or company name.

The `q` parameter is case-insensitive and supports ticker symbols,
alternate identifiers such as CUSIP, ISIN, and OPRA root,
and company names for non-option instruments. Results are ranked by match
quality plus instrument quality signals and relevance. Defaults to the `EQUITY` asset class (common
stocks, preferred shares, ADRs, ETFs, and exchange-traded mutual funds).
Pass `asset_class=OPTION` to search option contracts: by f
